title: Transformations
preview: Translations, reflections, rotations, and dilations on the coordinate plane, described with coordinate rules.
description: Students apply the four transformations on the coordinate plane — translations, reflections, rotations, and dilations — and describe each with coordinate rules, distinguishing the rigid motions (which preserve size) from dilations (which scale).

sections.label: 7-1 Translations
sections.description: Slide figures on the coordinate plane; describe the move with a coordinate rule.

sections.label: 7-2 Reflections
sections.description: Reflect figures across the x-axis and y-axis; describe with coordinate rules.

sections.label: 7-3 Rotations
sections.description: Rotate figures 90°, 180°, and 270° about the origin; discover the coordinate rules.

sections.label: 7-4 Dilations
sections.description: Dilate figures from the origin by a scale factor; connect to similarity.

source.name: Plug N Play
